messages:
eva: Quick gating question — rolling dedicated-east private VLAN later today. Security flagged HSM attestation + audit-log ingestion as must-haves before we flip. Who owns the auditlog pipeline for dedicated-east? Also noticed REDWOOD_KMS_KEY_ALIAS is not set in the dedicated config. cc @dom
chris: I'm the one building the auditlog pipeline but it's behind a feature flag right now. PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3456 :eyes: ETA to enable depends on env readiness.
jin: Checked the dedicated configs — you're right, REDWOOD_KMS_KEY_ALIAS is missing from dedicated-east. The runtime fails fast without it. Adding that env will unblock the attestation job.
dom: I can add the env and do a quick staging deploy. Which alias should I wire in for the rollout? @security-bot any objections if we use `test/rollout-key` temporarily in staging?
security-bot: sec-check: `test/rollout-key` is allowed for staging only. For production we require an HSM-backed alias: `hsm/prod/redwood-inference`. Also update attestation docs to include the KMS alias requirement.
kate: I can run the attestation smoke once the env is set. Steps I used last time:
``
export REDWOOD_KMS_KEY_ALIAS=hsm/prod/redwood-inference
./scripts/run-hsm-attest.sh --env dedicated-east
# then verify audit events in stackdriver: resource=auditlog, label=dedicated-east
```
If dom deploys to staging, I will kick off the smoke tests.
dom: On it — I'll add the var to the config manager and spin a staging deploy in ~20m. PR for infra change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-configs/pull/789
chris: I'll review both PRs once they're up. If the smoke passes, can we aim for a small canary today? Owners summary: dom = env + deploy, kate = smoke, chris = PR reviews, jin = config verification, eva = product sign-off.
eva: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate cutover window with the customer and sales. Ping me once the smoke finishes and attach any failing logs if the attest doesn't pass.
